metric_class: kinematic event-consistency metrics on a prescribed event/scene-conditioned ball path; not physical soccer task success
sample_size_note: One 144-frame sequence; 6 receive + 7 kick events and 6 transfer pairs are dependent samples from that single sequence.

definition.support_interval: Annotated kick frame - 8 through kick frame + 2.
definition.support_foot: Foot opposite the annotated kick foot.
definition.floor_proxy: Depth of ankle/toe keypoint below the fixed 0.012 m threshold.

smoothness.definition: Forward finite difference of order n multiplied by fps^n; root RMS uses Euclidean XYZ magnitude, joint RMS pools all frames and 29 DoF.
